name: E-methanol and bio-methanol
principle: Methanol is made from green hydrogen and biogenic or captured CO2 (e-methanol), or from biomass (bio-methanol). European Energy's Kassø plant in Denmark has three Siemens Energy electrolysers totalling 52.5 MW, uses biogenic CO2 from a local biogas plant, and produced its first e-methanol in March 2025 from the first of two methanol lines. Target output is 42,000 t.

performance.basis: article gives no time unit; electrolysers 52.5 MW

source.note: Hydrocarbon Processing, European Energy produces first e-methanol at Kassø, March 2025
